desc.en: Ribbons have long been popular as accessories among women, but this Angel Ribbon is well received among homunculi as well. The main secret to its success is the fact that it's shiny.
desc.ja: 長年、女性のための装飾品だったリボンだが、このエンゼルリボンはホムンクルスにも受け入れられた。主にきらきらと輝いているのが人気の秘密だという
